newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein softens in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein softens in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices softened in late trading on Wednesday amid the absence of buyers, traders said.
They said palm olein softened to 1,460 rupiah/kg in Jakarta against an opening price of 1,460-70. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,271 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
"There was no tender today and prices softened because of the absence of buyers. The market is still looking for direction amid a lack of fresh factors," said one trader.
Traders earlier said that a slight decline in Malaysian prices did not impact local sentiment.
